h: Tompolo reportedly donates 35 campaign vehicles for Tinubu's re-election drive in Adamawa
p: Niger Delta leader Government Ekpemupolo, known as Tompolo, has reportedly presented 35 vehicles to support President Tinubu's 2027 campaign in Adamawa State. The gesture is said to be part of efforts to strengthen the APC's base in the North-East.
more: Campaign vehicles and mobilisation have become a visible part of the early race.
